I keep discovering new bugs in this game, whether it's randomly losing FFB on specific tracks or the UI randomly acting as if buttons are being pushed. Combine that with an over-emphasis on microtransactions and an online experience full of trolls, this game is just not worth the $$.
Very frustrating to adjust settings and AI difficulty even on expert settings on multiple modes it wont let me move the AI difficulty slider.
Very Good F1 Game - Although AI cars are psychos in all dificulties so thanks EA

I played every f1 game so far but f1 23 was the first game that was actually enjoying for me with racing wheel
But just like every f1 games there are some pros and cons
Pros:-
1.Handling really great
2.Great improved graphics
3.using thrustmaster red legend racing wheel was a charm
4. Breaking Point 2 was great including the finishing compare to Breaking Point 1
5.Few track has been improved Austria, Spain
Cons:-
1. Podium Pass has been increased to lvl50 but still the same
2. Liberty most of them are copy past (can't create your own liberty compare to other games for ex- NFS or Forza)
3. Sponsors are same can't change the size or the positions
4. Singapore track no upgrade

Can't say about VR (I don't have a VR)
Cars handle well, and the new tracks are very fun. I'm having a good time with the F1 World stuff, but it is a little too easy if you get good enough parts early on like I did
I enjoyed it, wouldn't say its worth the £60 for normal or £80 for deluxe but on offer it is, the AI is better in this years and the ability to do the F2 -> F1 career paths neat

Mostly well polished though, as usual for sports games, quite similar to its predecessors. For some reason the image seems blurry if compared to the previous versions, maybe some kind of forced AA.

Gameplay is overall good, still has severe issues with the penalty system in online modes (enjoy that 5 second penalty because whoever was trailing you got frustrated and decided not to break before the next turn). As someone who used to have a wheel, playing with the controller is much inferior but not completely unplayable like on other simulators. Online at least finally has a timeout system and indicators for people who crash on loading which was rather common in F1 21.

Not sure I dig the Fifa-like approach to menu music here.

One thing I think this game is still missing is a tutorial on stuff like tackling different types of turn, proper pedal (or triggers I guess) usage and such. If there is a game that is a massive door for "sim-ish" racing, that game is F1, but it doesn't capitalize on that. Combine that with the voice chat enabled elitists and the game ends up having the opposite effect. Still, most of the game works well or fine enough so it gets a recommendation.
Solid graphics, good story and cut scenes. The races are bit to easy for the campaign but the races are highly addictive. The sound of the cars...is just music

Great game, improved on and fixed some of the bugs found in f1 22, and includes some extra tracts that were not on the calendar this season. also contains the next season of braking point, a campaign where you follow Aiden Jackson join a new team to the grid with rival Devon Butler. overall the game is fun. as usual, there hasn't been that big of a difference between games, so if you own f1 22, it might be worth waiting for a sale to buy it, but if you are just getting in to it, it's definitely worth getting.

Better handling than F1 22 and this game just feels better. You can actually feel the car slide out from under you unlike last game. Makes having TCS off a lot more fun. The AI do tend to block like crazy though in this game and I'm not sure if they were like that in 22 but oh well, it's still very fun.
Definitely an upgrade to the 22' game some much-needed features have been added ,and the graphics have been greatly updated!

VR version is broken with Quest 2, the game keeps losing focus and you need to take your headset off and alt-tab into the game window repeatedly until you have loaded a race. And the game doesn't work OpenComposite, so, the performance is pretty bad.
its very realistic and does what a game is supposed to do, i.e let you escape the real world, i basically forget about time when im playing f1 23, its just so spectacular

F123 is one of my favorite racing sims. It works really well with wheel support and a smooth VR support for a true experience if you want to really feel your going doing a straight at 350 kmh. I like how you can adjust the difficulty and external devices work well for telemetry numbers and detailed information for all of your sim needs.

The handling is so much better than f1 22, but apart from that nothing really changed.
enough bugs in the game to not even wanna start a career mode because something will go wrong and you can start all over again. F1 world while fun for a while, i think just isn't formula 1 with the perks. story mode is nice but still way to easy so no challenge in it. visually beautifull.

But the absolute worst thing is the AI, still as bad as in f1 22. they will not hesitate to overtake in the most dumb corners and ways most of the time completely ignoring your existence. Some races it's fine and others you can reset as many times as you like but you are still gonna get taken out.

At least for now in my opinion fun for time trial or some races with friends, but the rest is just not good enough

Anyway, cool game! Much better than 22, but still too much fluff that can make the game a little difficult to navigate.

VR in this game is terrible. I have no idea how they decided this was ready for production. It's shaking constantly, which is nauseating, no feedback from the game (at least in time trial, no idea if I cut a corner or not, it literally doesn't say), no lock to horizon, the game stops working after you open the Oculus menu, sign up doesn't work at all when you first open the game, the list goes on and all that in... well, see my playtime above. It's just an embarrassing disaster for people who got this for the VR racing experience, completely unplayable.

Hopefully they fix it, but with the way this game series has evolved (or more accurately, hasn't), I do not believe we'll ever see a decent VR experience in the official F1 game.

It's not even like this is impossible to do, AMS2, AC, ACC, Dirt Rally, so many other games nail this. Somehow this is literally the worst possible VR experience on the market, with the biggest company behind it.
This is the best F1 game since F1 2014. Got the car setup pretty quick and won the first race I ran,

Quite good if your looking for an arcade, but still realistic racing game. Good handling in my opinion, bugs do happen from time to time, but are mostly easy to get around. F1™ World isn't pay to win. Ranked Multiplayer is scuffed but in my opinion, a few tweaks and it would be great. The graphics are amazing, the amount of options for AI difficulty is great (0% Difficulty to 110% Difficulty). And the sense of speed when you get everything right is amazing. And tons of leagues to chose from. A few things that could be fixed, but overall a great game that anyone can get the hang of, 8/10.
This game made me realise, that my 2016 Opel Corsa has better cornering Abilities than both a Ferrari Roma and a Mercedes AMG GT-R Black Series. I should've put that in the Ad when I sold it

Better handling and more fun to drive, but don't be fooled, aside from a couple of updated game modes such as F1 World (which so far is too easy), this game is the same as F1 22 when it comes to My Team and Career modes. If you expected more than this, you'll be somewhat disappointed. I love the F1 games, but EA's influence and Codies inability for whatever reason to update the current game engine means it's more like papering over the cracks than a fresh lick of paint.

tldr.text: Very Positive (85%): players love the graphics and art, while bugs and crashes are the main complaint.
Recent reviews are more positive than the all-time score.

details.text: Early players are far less happy: 49% are positive, against 87% of those a few hours in.
For a buyer today, bugs and crashes are the main risk, since 18% of reviews complain about them.
